customerComment: The seasonal omakase was breathtaking. Every course was crafted with such precision and artistry. The toro melted on the tongue and the matcha dessert was the ideal ending.
ownerReply: Arigato gozaimasu Alice! Chef Hiroshi and our kitchen team are delighted that the omakase and matcha dessert resonated with you. We hope to welcome you back next season.

customerComment: Exquisite dining experience in the private Tatami room. The ambiance with garden views and soft koto music makes you forget you are in the middle of the city.
ownerReply: Thank you Ben! The Tatami room is designed specifically for serene, intimate evenings. We are glad you enjoyed the view and music.

customerComment: Superb wagyu beef and crispy tempura. Service was very attentive and courteous throughout. Only minus was that parking took a while on a busy Friday night.
Unmatched sake selection! The sommelier paired each dish wonderfully. The salmon sashimi was remarkably fresh and pristine.
ownerReply: Thank you Daniel! Our sake pairings are curated with passionate local breweries. Looking forward to your next visit!

customerComment: Celebrated our anniversary here and it could not have been more memorable. The team surprised us with a personalized dessert plate. Outstanding hospitality!
ownerReply: Happy anniversary Emma! It was our genuine pleasure to celebrate this milestone with you both. Warmest wishes from the entire Sakura Garden team.

customerComment: The dragon roll and miso glazed black cod were sensational. Cozy aesthetic and pleasant service. Will recommend to all my friends visiting Kyoto.
Authentic Edo-style sushi at its finest. You can taste the dedication in the rice seasoning and knife technique. A top tier culinary experience.
ownerReply: Honored by your review, Leo. Preserving traditional Edo-style craftsmanship is at the heart of our kitchen. We look forward to your return.

customerComment: Delightful dinner! The unagi don was tender and perfectly glazed. The garden lighting in the evening creates a magical romantic atmosphere.
Freshness is next level. The chef explained the origin of each fish which added so much depth to our meal. Easily the best sushi in town.
ownerReply: Thank you Marcus! We believe every catch has a story to tell, and our chefs love sharing it with our guests.

customerComment: Came back for business lunch and was thoroughly impressed again. Fast, refined service, and the bento box selection is top notch.
Great vegetarian options alongside the seafood! The agedashi tofu and mushroom hotpot were rich in flavor and deeply satisfying.
The chawanmushi and soft-shell crab hand rolls were absolute showstoppers. Cozy booth seating made our conversation easy and enjoyable.
The food was delectable as always, but our table was situated near the kitchen door which got a bit noisy during the peak rush hour.
ownerReply: Thank you for the candid feedback Daniel. We apologize for the kitchen noise distraction and will make sure you are seated in our quieter garden wing on your next visit.

customerComment: Perfection from start to finish. The yellowtail with jalapeño was refreshing, and the black sesame ice cream was divine.
Top tier dining! Beautiful plating, impeccable service, and calm Japanese zen garden ambiance. Worth every penny.
Very fresh nigiri set and authentic dashi broth. The staff greeted us warmly from the moment we stepped through the entrance.
A peaceful sanctuary with delicious food. The green tea cocktail was unique and refreshing. Highly recommend booking a garden table.
Exceeded all our expectations. The chef selection nigiri platter was art on a plate. Cannot wait to return!
Wonderful dinner with friends. The spicy tuna tartare and tempura udon were stellar. Great attention to dietary preferences too.
